issue.title: Speed up test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection's whole-repo collect-only
issue.description: tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection runs a whole-repo pytest --collect-only to verify the checked-in contract manifest matches marker selection. Measured at 32.4s on the dev host at HEAD (2026-08-06), well above the epic plan's ~21s estimate, making tests/test_contract_manifest.py cost roughly 58s of every full-suite run -- more than the ~23s contract set it guards. Investigate a cheaper way to verify manifest/marker sync (e.g. caching collection, narrowing the collect-only scope, or reusing an existing collection pass) without weakening the guard. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3); discovered and measured during sase-fp.8.1 (Load- and machine-normalized contract-set budget guard).
